order.title: 1 · In / out of
instructions: Put the ball in the box.
Take the ball out of the box.
Put the pen in the pocket.
Take the pen out of the pocket.

order.title: 2 · On / under
instructions: Put the ball on the chair.
Put the ball under the chair.
Put the book on the table.
Put the book under the table.

order.title: 3 · Beside
instructions: Put the ball beside the box.
Put the pen beside the book.
Put the toy car beside the chair.

order.title: 4 · In front of / behind
instructions: Put the ball in front of the chair.
Put the ball behind the chair.
Put the toy car in front of the box.
Put the toy car behind the box.

order.title: 5 · Between
instructions: Put the ball between the two boxes.
Put the pen between the two books.
Put the toy car between the chair and the table.

order.title: 6 · Above / below
instructions: Move the balloon above the table.
Move the balloon below the table.
Move the star above the cloud.
Move the star below the cloud.

order.title: 7 · Near / far from
instructions: Put the ball near the tree.
Put the ball far from the tree.
Put the toy car near the house.
Put the toy car far from the house.

order.title: 8 · Into / out of
instructions: Move the toy car into the garage.
Move the toy car out of the garage.
Move the ball into the box.
Move the ball out of the box.

order.title: 9 · Over / through
instructions: Move the ball over the low wall.
Move the ball through the hoop.
Move the toy car through the tunnel.

order.title: 10 · Across / around
instructions: Move the toy car across the bridge.
Move the toy car around the tree.
Move the boat across the pond.

order.title: Final review · Two steps
instructions: Take the ball out of the box. Put it under the chair.
Put the book on the table. Put the pen beside the book.
Move the toy car out of the garage. Put it behind the box.
order.unlocks: After all individual lessons are practised
